content:
200 Returned if the scanner linking key was retrieved successfully.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string
The linking key, that is, the alpha-numeric sequence of characters you
use to link a scanner to Tenable Vulnerability Management. For more
information about linking a scanner, see the Link a Sensor in the Tenable
Vulnerability Management User Guide.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to view scanner data.
— 404 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management cannot find the specified scanner.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
